sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Steven G. Hawkins.
He was involved in the Ben Schneider (Reckless Ben) investigation.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Steven G. Hawkins began working for the American Fork Police Department on July 4, 2022.

sections.title: Related Police Encounters
descriptions: Officer Spencer Tonga was involved in several stages of the Reckless Ben matter. He responded to and prepared the report for the March 8, 2026, trespassing complaint, submitted a probable-cause statement prepared by Detective Nicosia for Benjamin Schneider’s March 11 stalking arrest, and participated in executing the related search warrant at Schneider’s Airbnb.
